← Toolkit

Quiz / Review Game Board

Lets you keep more than one game board saved at once (e.g. one per unit).

Splits a saved roster into teams by count instead of typing team names by hand. Rosters saved elsewhere on this device under “np_rosters” show up in the dropdown below. Team names are pre-filled and stay editable on the scoreboard afterward, same as typed-in teams.

Each question can carry a picture — a map, a diagram, a political cartoon, a primary source. Use + Image on a row. Pictures are shrunk on the way in, stored inside the board (so they travel with a JSON export), shown with the clue on the projector, and printed on the practice quiz and answer key.

Spreadsheet needs four columns, one row per question: Category, Points, Question, Answer. The first row should be that header row.

While a clue is open: Space reveal · 1-9 award · Esc close

A reusable pool of questions for this tool's boards, separate from any one board — tag a question by unit, standard and difficulty once, then reuse it across boards and across years. Pulling a question into a board copies it in; editing or deleting it here afterward doesn't change a board that already pulled it.

Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded, including any spreadsheet you import.
